info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Review Submission API
info.description: The Customer Review Submission API enables users to submit feedback on card clearing transactions. This API is crucial for financial institutions looking to enhance customer experience by capturing and analyzing client opinions. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can gather insights on their payment processes and improve service quality. Typical consumers include banking applications and payment platforms, providing an interactive interface for users to express their satisfaction or concerns.

post.summary: Submit a review for a specific card clearing transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the card clearing transaction identified by CARD-400045. Users can provide feedback regarding their experience with the transaction, which can help improve service quality.
